behavior_under_test: Directory discovery ignores a Python symbolic link whose resolved target is outside the discovery root while continuing to discover an in-root Python file.
ground_truth_basis: The public Black API documents this observable directory-discovery behavior; the evaluator test uses a real temporary directory and external symlink rather than the historical mock-based regression test.
independence: Independent evaluator test with different filesystem objects and assertions from the historical regression test.
limitations: The check requires symbolic-link support from the evaluator host.
